scope: Historical native LAN acceptance fixture only. Production code and packaged runtime remain unchanged.

initialFailure.description: One manual-IP fill action timed out waiting for editability before gameplay. A diagnostic-only rerun passed before the input/window correction, so the initial cause is not proven.

naturalRetryFailure.description: Second forced all-dead did not reach debrief once; a diagnostic-only rerun passed. The old fixture mutated each predicted head independently. It now injects the same original all-dead state at a shared future simulation tick on every replay, retaining traces and original natural-end/retry assertions. Initial causation is not claimed as proven.

resumeCoordinateFailure.description: The historical final resume click targeted the old centered coordinate after the new side-by-side layout. The modern branch clicks the visible button actual bounds through Presenter; the legacy coordinate remains.

correction: Real mouse focus and keyboard typing replace fill(), with explicit visibility, typed-value and retained-focus checks.
Functional native windows are born transparent and non-focusable, positioned on the normal display and bounded to 640x480 during gameplay.
Native resize coverage keeps real window resizing and now asserts the requested viewport sizes. Original gameplay, camera, pause, retry and recovery assertions remain.
Natural all-dead injection runs inside the simulation collection phase on a common future tick, including rollback replay.
Modern resume uses the visible button bounds; legacy coordinates remain.
Host/client handles are assigned to the outer cleanup scope, so finally awaits their close before writing the report.
Failed v023/netretry runs collect both peer screenshots and state before process cleanup.
releaseEvidence: Earlier passed gates are reused only for the identical verified asar, with source identities retained for all segments.
